intent: From candidate URL to configured watch, as a procedure anyone could repeat.
change: The committed site-onboarding procedure and its first executions once sites are chosen: robots/ToS check recorded, fetch-tier decision, extractor bootstrap from live pages, allowlist entries, per-check cost estimate and minimum-interval budget, site_connection setup for the action service - each onboarding recorded as a document in the repo.
done_when: The procedure document exists and 2-3 chosen sites are onboarded through it with complete records (tier justification, cost estimate, check budget, anomalies and dispositions), and the resulting watches/connection are configured in the production database.

intent: The watch engine against pages that never agreed to be easy.
change: The onboarded watches running on real schedules through unmodified s2 machinery: observation series accumulating, one genuine change notification delivered over Telegram, one drift episode resolved (tier-appropriate self-heal or recorded attended fix), needs-attention pausing proven if a site defeats its top tier.
done_when: The per-site evidence bundle is committed: onboarding record, three days of observation series visible on the dashboard, a delivered change notification with its event row, and a drift episode with resolution - with no engine modifications required (gaps filed to owning sprints).

intent: One real cancellation, full guardrails, zero shortcuts, tape rolling.
change: The real-action execution against the owned low-stakes service: playbook-or-agentic decision recorded, the confirm-gated production run to a service-confirmed cancellation with events, cost, recording echo, and watchable replay; the decline run; the fixture-analogue rehearsal; re-subscription procedure; post-run session-ledger leak check.
done_when: The evidence bundle is committed: succeeded task with trail and replay, service-side confirmation reference, decline-run record, zero-leak ledger check, re-subscription note, and the fixture rehearsal green - with guardrails untouched by any real-site exception.

intent: The nightly gate: real sessions, real watches, real costs, one honest verdict per night.
change: The nightly workflow expanded from the s1 smoke into the live ops suite: session-lifecycle case, real-watch check cases, a fixture-target production mission, the s6 live evals, distinct pass/failed/errored reporting with the two-night errored rule, per-run cost summation against the agreed target, and red-night Telegram ops notification through sendToUser.
done_when: The suite runs on schedule with all case classes reporting distinctly; unit tests cover green/errored/failed counting and cost summation; a deliberately broken case turns the night red and delivers the ops notification; cost totals reconcile with per-task records.

intent: The ship permit: three green nights on record and every checklist item signed.
change: The manual release checklist committed (secrets audit, session-leak ledger, guardrail arming, replay spot-check, cost review) with named-and-dated attestation entries; the three-consecutive-green-nights record accumulated and committed; the cost target agreed with Aarav and the nightly totals recorded against it.
done_when: The committed record shows three consecutive green nights under the cost target and a fully attested checklist, and s10's deploy task can cite both files as its precondition.
